blurb: A handler declared `by u: User` runs as a verified actor, and a `case` has no real caller, so it must say who is calling with a call-site `by`. The same applies to a handler guarded by an actor sum: name one of its members. Append `by <Actor>(<identity>)` to the call.
summary: A test drives an identity-carrying handler, or one guarded by an actor sum, with no call-site `by <Actor>`.
